description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Amendment to the Order under Sec 3 of Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the amendment of stamp duty regulations under the Stamp Duty (Special Provisions) Act, No. 12 of 2006. It contains legal/regulatory content including statutory instruments, amendments to existing orders, and specific regulatory provisions regarding license fees. While it mentions Minister Mangala Samaraweera, this is incidental to the legal/regulatory nature of the content, which focuses on modifying legal frameworks and compliance requirements rather than government personnel or structural changes.
